abstract: Endometrial carcinoma with a germ cell tumor component is a rare event. Here we report a uterine neoplasm with a unique combination of endometrioid adenocarcinoma and mixed germ cell malignant elements. A 28-year-old woman with abnormal vaginal bleeding, an abdominal mass, and elevated alfa-fetoprotein and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) levels had a history of biopsy of an omental mass and chemotherapy in another hospital one month before her referral to our department. Histologic examination of the mass removed from the omentum revealed an endometrioid adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor-like differentiation. Total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, infracolic omentectomy, and removal of metastatic disease were then undertaken at our hospital. Postoperative chemotherapy was given. Eight months postoperatively, serum alfa-fetoprotein and β-hCG rose again. Cases with primary yolk sac tumors of the endometrium or endometrial carcinoma with trophoblastic differentiation in the literature were reviewed.
abstract_ja: 子宮内膜癌に胚細胞腫瘍成分を伴うことは稀な事象である。本稿では、類内膜腺癌と混合性胚細胞悪性成分という独特の組み合わせを示した子宮腫瘍を報告する。28歳女性が異常な膣出血、腹部腫瘤、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGの高値を呈していた。本患者は、他院で大網腫瘤の生検と化学療法を受けた1か月後に当院を紹介受診した。大網腫瘤切除標本の組織学的検査で、卵黄嚢腫瘍様分化を伴う類内膜腺癌が認められた。当院では、腹式子宮全摘術、両側卵管卵巣摘出術、結腸下大網切除、転移性疾患の切除を行った。術後化学療法を施行した。術後8か月で血清AFPおよびβ-hCGが再上昇した。文献上の子宮内膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍および栄養膜分化を伴う子宮内膜癌の症例を再検討した。
